hero.title: About Ranthambore
hero.subtitle: Based directly in Sawai Madhopur, we are an independent wildlife safari facilitation agency dedicated to ethical tiger tracking, authentic naturalist guidance, and verified park permits.

blocks.heading: Passionate Trackers. Unmatched Safaris.
blocks.body:
Founded by wildlife enthusiasts and local naturalists in Sawai Madhopur, Ranthambore Wild Life Tour is an independent travel facilitation company dedicated to delivering authentic, transparent, and exhilarating wildlife expeditions.

From securing coveted morning Gypsy permits to booking heritage jungle resorts, our on-ground team takes care of every detail so you can immerse yourself in the majestic wilderness of Ranthambore.

**12+ Decade of Excellence** — Dedicated to ethical Ranthambore wildlife tourism

blocks.heading: Ranthambore National Park: Brief Journey
blocks.intro: From royal game preserve in 1955 to a globally celebrated Project Tiger haven.

items.title: Sawai Madhopur Gaming Sanctuary
items.text: Originally designated as the Sawai Madhopur Gaming Sanctuary to safeguard royal hunting grounds.

items.title: Project Tiger Reserve Induction
items.text: Ranthambore was brought under the national Project Tiger initiative to establish dedicated tiger conservation reserves.

items.title: Declared a National Park
items.text: The central core forest spanning 282 sq km was officially declared a National Park, instituting strict protection.

items.title: Mansingh & Keladevi Sanctuaries
items.text: Deciduous woodlands of Sawai Mansingh and Keladevi Sanctuaries were notified to create vital tiger corridors.

items.title: Greater Ranthambore Tiger Reserve
items.text: Amalgamated into the Greater Ranthambore Tiger Reserve, encompassing over 1,300 sq km of protected wild habitat.

items.title: Wildlife First Ethos
items.text: We maintain respectful distances from tigers and wild animals, adhering to forest speed limits and zero-noise codes.

items.title: Transparent Quotas
items.text: No false promises. We educate guests on the official 10-zone lottery and provide genuine government receipts.

items.title: Community Empowerment
items.text: 100% of our drivers, naturalists, and desk managers are local residents of Sawai Madhopur and surrounding villages.
